patterns_discovered.name: Legacy System Decommissioning Gap
patterns_discovered.description: Improperly decommissioned cloud resources create persistent security vulnerabilities
patterns_discovered.evidence: Checkout.com security incident (425 HN score) - legacy third-party cloud file storage system from 2020 not properly decommissioned. Attackers gained unauthorized access.
patterns_discovered.applicability_to_chained: HIGH - Multiple legacy resources likely exist from early development
patterns_discovered.expected_impact: High security improvement, moderate cost savings

patterns_discovered.name: Hidden Multi-Cloud Data Transfer Costs
patterns_discovered.description: Internet egress charges can equal or exceed compute costs in multi-cloud architectures
patterns_discovered.evidence: Prosopo case study (136 HN score) - $1,000/month data transfer costs (33% of total $3,000 bill) due to multi-cloud architecture. Data transfer over internet cost as much as servers.
mitigation_strategies: Use Cloud CDN for static content
patterns_discovered.applicability_to_chained: MEDIUM - Currently single-cloud (GCP), future risk if expanding
patterns_discovered.implementation_complexity: Low for monitoring, High for architectural changes

patterns_discovered.name: Self-Hosting for Cost Optimization
patterns_discovered.description: Mature workloads can achieve 60-90% cost reduction through self-hosting
patterns_discovered.evidence: Prosopo achieved 90% cost reduction ($3,000 → $300/month) by migrating MongoDB from Atlas to self-managed Hetzner deployment
patterns_discovered.applicability_to_chained: LOW - Too early stage, benefits of managed services outweigh costs
